item.title: Backup for Freedom: OVHcloud Backup Center runs on Plakar
item.description: OVHcloud presented Backup Center at its AI Summit: native backup for Public Cloud, built on the open-source Plakar engine. Managed Kubernetes comes first, with a free Beta and general availability in early 2027.
